# Thread: How many tools one member may hold at a time

## Goal

Settle a per-member limit on open loans that stewards can live with, and decide whether a steward may lift it for one member.

## Context

*Created 2026-03-27.*

- Stewards report a few members holding six or more tools for weeks, which leaves popular tools out of the sheds.
- The roles work in phase 2 already lets a steward set what a member may do per shed, so a limit could ride on the same setting.

## References

- `.planning/PROJECT.md` — the core value a limit has to protect
- Steward desk request from the March sync, no ticket number

## Next Steps

1. Count open loans per member from the last quarter and see how many exceed four.
2. Draft the limit as a per-shed setting and show it to two stewards.
3. Decide whether lifting the limit for one member needs a reason on record.
